t: Written Communist Posters Found Pasted On A Telephone

pages.en:
Form No. 3
G. 25,000-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. D. 5821 Date 19 / 4 / 34）
Date... April 18, 1934.

Subject (in full) Written communist posters found pasted on a telephone pole
on N.Szechuen Road near Kiangwan Road on April 18, 1934.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

I forward herewith two written communist posters
which were found by the Municipal Police exhibited on a
telephone standard on North Szechuen Road near Kiangwan Road
at 10 a.m. April 18, 1934. A translation of the posters
reads as follows :-
(a) Unemployed workers, let us besiege the Shanghai
City Government and demand food from the Authorities!
(b) Overthrow Imperialism which aims at the
partition of China!

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Jul / JZ）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.2，特别股。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别股登记处。档案号 D. 5821 日期 19 / 4 / 34）
日期……1934年4月18日。

事由（全称）1934年4月18日在靠近江湾路的北四川路电话线杆上发现张贴的共产党手写标语。

由督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）呈报 [签名]

现随文附上两张共产党手写标语，系市政警察于1934年4月18日上午10时，在北四川路靠近江湾路处的电话线杆上查获并展示。标语译文如下：
(a) 失业工人们，让我们包围上海市政府，向当局要求食物！
(b) 打倒旨在瓜分中国的帝国主义！

顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）
督察

特别股主管警官。

（批注：Jul / JZ）
